title: Day 750: Woman Shot Inside Business at Barrancos Shopping Plaza in Culiacán
detail: A woman was shot inside a business at a commercial plaza in the Barrancos sector of southern Culiacán around 10:06 PM on Wednesday, August 12, 2026, at the intersection of Avenida Giovanni Zamudio and Antonio Nakayama, near a well-known shopping center. Witnesses reported hearing gunfire before emergency responders arrived. Red Cross paramedics treated her at the scene before transporting her to a hospital; her condition was not disclosed. State Police and Mexican Army personnel secured the perimeter while investigators worked the scene. No arrests have been reported.

media.caption: Woman wounded by gunfire inside a Barrancos-sector business, Culiacán, August 12, 2026
